LEGENDS SCRIPTING API
Player API
Access and control the player instance inside your mod script.
Player.getHealth() Player.setHealth(20) Player.giveItem("iron_sword", 1) Player.teleport(x, y, z) Player.sendMessage("Hello!")
Block API
Read or modify blocks in the world at runtime.
World.getBlock(x, y, z) World.setBlock(x, y, z, "stone") World.breakBlock(x, y, z) World.isSolid(x, y, z)
Event Handlers
Listen for in-game events and run your own logic.
on("playerJoin", function(player) { console.log(player.name + " joined the world"); }); on("blockBreak", function(player, block) { console.log(player.name + " broke " + block.type); }); on("playerChat", function(player, message) { console.log("[Chat] " + player.name + ": " + message); });
Console
Print debug output to the Live Console Output panel.
console.log("Info message") console.warn("Warning message") console.error("Error message")
